notes: The image shows the breadboard with rows f-j at the top and a-e at the bottom; mapped to catalogue naming (bank 'b' = rows f-j, bank 't' = rows a-e), with columns 9-12 as labelled in the image.
LED legs in columns 9,10,11,12 = R, COM (longest, common anode), G, B, in the image's order; COM is connected to 5V via the red wire in column 10.
Each resistor spans the centre gap (row f to row e) in columns 9, 11, 12; the pin wires land in rows d/c/b of the same columns: pin 3 -> col 9 (red), pin 5 -> col 11 (green), pin 6 -> col 12 (blue).
Resistors are listed as 220 ohm per the manual's text and schematic.
The 5V wire attaches to the Uno 5V header pin (power connector), as in the circuit image.
No code-driven connections are modelled; the sketch only drives the pins.
